title: Brass birdcage luggage cart · original Blender model
author: the internet slop warehouse
description: Brass birdcage bellman's luggage cart, 112 x 62 x 188 cm: two 1.5 in brass arched side frames leaning into a cast crown hub with finial and garment bar, push bars at both ends with cast tee sleeves, flared base ferrules, carpeted deck (ambientCG Fabric026, worn pale in the middle) in a brass skirt with a grey rubber wrap-around bumper (scuffed), 2 fixed 8 in cushion wheels and 2 swivel 5 in casters (one turned sideways). Brass is metal PBR with a generated wear map: hand-polished at grab height, tarnished and rougher low down and at the joints, fingerprint smudges. Hooks: grab, deck, caster_l, caster_r. Built by projects/roadside-inn/blender/luggage.py. Original CC0.

title: Brass birdcage luggage cart (phone LOD) · original Blender model
author: the internet slop warehouse
description: Phone level of detail of hotel-luggage-cart-brass: the same model with dense meshes decimated to about 30 % and textures at most 512 px; names, materials and hook nodes unchanged. Built by projects/roadside-inn/blender/mobile_lod.py from hotel-luggage-cart-brass. Original CC0.

title: Soft-side 22 in carry-on (rollaboard) · original Blender model
author: the internet slop warehouse
description: Two-wheel soft-side carry-on, 36 x 25 x 57 cm closed: charcoal 1680D ballistic nylon (ambientCG Fabric004) body, expansion gusset and front lid with a zip pocket (creased), black piping on every edge, perimeter and expansion zips with metal pulls, padded top and side handles, blank paper airline tag, moulded wheel housings with 7 cm PU inline wheels, kick plate and front feet (scraped), scuffed corners, two-tube aluminium telescoping handle with grip and release button. Hooks: handle (slides +Y 0.42 m), grab_top, wheel_l, wheel_r. Built by projects/roadside-inn/blender/luggage.py. Original CC0.
